changes: Amudi placed existing CC0 English passages next to uniquely corroborated Hebrew-Aramaic passages. The source editions have different segmentation and wording; matches use ordered word similarity and are not claims of verbatim identity. Multiple non-overlapping English excerpts for one paragraph are grouped and labeled as partial translations. Translations spanning adjacent paragraphs are labeled with their passage numbers. Blank slots remain untranslated. No new translation or OCR was performed. One excerpt is withheld pending source-rights review.
method: Unique paragraph candidate, at least three shared four-word shingles and 80% ordered-word coverage in both directions; duplicate local claims excluded. This is evidence of passage correspondence, not exact edition identity.
partialMethod: Partial translation for a uniquely matched portion of an unclaimed local paragraph, requiring 90% ordered source-word coverage and at least 20 matching words; multiple accepted intervals in one paragraph cannot overlap. No comparison-source text copied.
spanningMethod: Unique adjacent paragraphs within the same reader section, requiring at least 90% source-word and 80% target-group ordered coverage, at least eight matching words per paragraph and no overlap with existing or other proposed translations. Source comparison text is research-only.

comparisonSourceEvidence.use: Passage comparison only; its text is not distributed.

withheldRecords.reason: Distinctive wording overlaps the 1933 Soncino translation; relationship and rights need review.
